speaker: agent
text: Good afternoon, thank you for calling the Grand View Hotel and Suite.

text: All right, I see that you're currently booked for a king deluxe room for two nights. Checking out Monday morning, is that correct?

text: Oh, perfect. Okay, so you're interested in an upgrade. So we have a few options that might suit an anniversary celebration.

text: Yeah, absolutely, we can check that. So we currently have two suite types available for your dates.

text: There's the executive suite, so it has a separate living area, city, skyline view and a deep soaking tub.

text: And the honeymoon suite offers a jacuzzi, a balcony overlooking the river and has complimentary champagne and chocolate strawberries upon arrival.

text: Hmm, that second one sounds like it was made for us. What's the price difference compared to what I already asked?

speaker: agent
text: Yeah, let's take a look. So your current rate for the king deluxe room is $225 per night.

text: So the executive suite is $310 per night and the honeymoon suite is $365 per night.

text: Since it's an anniversary, I can apply our celebration offer, so it gives you 10% off suite upgrades.

text: So that would bring this honeymoon suite down to about $329 per night.

text: Yeah, it is, but I should mention we just have one of those suites and the weekends tend to book quickly.

speaker: agent
text: But if you'd like, I can hold it for up to 15 minutes while you decide or we can upgrade you right now to secure it.

text: Okay, let's go ahead and upgrade now. My wife will love that jacuzzi in the balcony. Yeah.

text: Excellent choice. Okay, so I'll make that change for you.

text: So would you like me to keep the same payment method on file for the difference?

text: Okay. So while I'm finalizing the upgrade, would you like me to go over the amenities that's included with your new suite?

speaker: customer
text: Would that be great?

speaker: agent
text: Okay, so the honeymoon suite includes a private jacuzzi tub and furnished balcony with a river view, complimentary welcome champagne and desserts,

speaker: agent
text: 24-hour room service and turned down service in the evening, access to the executive lounge, which offers breakfast, snacks and evening cocktails,

text: permanent free Wi-Fi, spa access and priority check-in service.

text: And you'll also receive early access to our spa facilities if you'd like to book a couple's massage during your stay.

text: Oh, that would be a wonderful surprise. I can send you a link to our spa menu and you can book a treatment directly through your guest portal.

speaker: agent
text: Okay.
